from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data extracted from one company's 2025 Q1 report"""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code(s) for the company")
    weighted_average_roe: float | None = Field(description="Weighted average return on net assets percentage for Q1 2025")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2025 Q1'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the ROE value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_data: list[CompanyFinancialData]
